.. change::
    :tags: feature, mssql
    :tickets: 13218

    Added ``use_bulkcopy`` parameter to the :ref:`mssql+mssqlpython <mssql_mssqlpython>`
    dialect, which routes ``executemany()`` INSERT operations through the
    ``cursor.bulkcopy()`` API for dramatically faster write performance using
    SQL Server's native TDS bulk load protocol.  This is analogous to the
    ``fast_executemany`` parameter on the :ref:`pyodbc <mssql_pyodbc>` dialect.
    Additional parameters ``bulkcopy_batch_size`` and ``bulkcopy_table_lock``
    are also available.
